review.note: Places picked by Waypoint from the Wikidata list. Descriptions come from the first sentence of each place's Wikipedia article (descBy: wikipedia, with the article link in ground) and otherwise from Waypoint's own text (descBy: curated). Not checked against official tourism sites. Hours, prices and closures change: verify on the official source before you go.

desc.en: Druskininkai is a spa city on the Nemunas River in southern Lithuania, close to the borders of Belarus and Poland.
desc.es: Localidad balneario en el sur de Lituania, junto al río Néman.

desc.en: Grūtas Park is a socialist realism museum with a sculpture garden of Soviet-era statues and other Soviet ideological relics from the times of the Soviet occupation.
desc.es: Parque al aire libre con estatuas de la era soviética, en el sur de Lituania.

desc.en: The National Museum of Lithuania, established in 1952, is a state-sponsored historical museum that encompasses several significant structures and a wide collection of written materials and artifacts.
desc.es: El Museo Nacional de Lituania, establecido en 1952, es un museo estatal histórico, ubicado en el Nuevo arsenal del complejo de castillos de Vilna, capital de Lituania.

desc.en: Lithuanian Zoological Garden previously known as Kaunas' Zoological Garden is the oldest scientific zoo in Lithuania.
desc.es: El Jardín zoológico Lituano es el único zoológico en el país europeo de Lituania.

places.name: Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights

desc.en: The Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights in Vilnius is dedicated to showing artifacts and records from the 50-year Soviet occupation of Lithuania.

desc.en: Žmuidzinavičius Museum, also known as the Devil Museum, is a museum in Kaunas, Lithuania, dedicated to collecting and exhibiting sculptures and carvings of devils from all over the world.
desc.es: Museo Žmuidzinavičius, comúnmente conocido como Museo del demonio, es un museo ubicado en Kaunas (Lituania), dedicado a coleccionar y exhibir esculturas y tallas de demonios procedentes de todo el mundo.

desc.en: The House of the Signatories is a Lithuanian historic landmark on Pilies Street, Vilnius, where on February 16, 1918, the Act of Independence of Lithuania was signed by twenty members…
desc.es: Casa de Vilna donde se firmó el acta de independencia de Lituania de 1918.

places.name: M. K. Čiurlionis National Art Museum

desc.en: The M. K. Čiurlionis National Art Museum is a group of museums based in Kaunas, Lithuania.
desc.es: El Museo Nacional de Arte Mikalojus Konstantinas Čiurlionis es un grupo de museos ubicados en Kaunas, Lituania.
